title: Take the Rook on Your Doorstep
setup: Black's rook on c1 is checking your king on c3, and Black's queen on b8 and rook on e7 are waiting behind it.
hint: The piece giving you trouble is also the piece nearest Black's king. Ask what your rook can do once it is gone.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxc1+}} removes the intruder with check. {{Ke2}} and {{Kf2}} lose alike to {{Rg2#}}, because the bishop on a8 guards g2 from the far corner. The move that saved your king and the move that trapped Black's were the same one.
